author: Maria Edgeworth
description: "Murad the Unlucky" by Maria Edgeworth is a collection of tales written during the early 19th century that explores themes of fortune, fate, and human character.
longDescription: The stories often focus on contrasting characters, particularly through the titular figure, Murad, who is described as the embodiment of misfortune, and his brother Saladin, who is depicted as fortunate.

authorInfo.bio: Maria Edgeworth (1768–1849) wrote Murad the Unlucky, and Other Tales. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
